options.label: A
options.name: Round-screen hood: big concrete hood, round screen-face, tall slate box on the back
options.question: A big hood frames a round screen-face (the do-not-disturb crescent); the pack is a tall slate box that shows past both shoulders.
parts: delivery box (slate, lid seam, stencil, neon-pink logo): layer 0 (back); back; bobs 1 px a step late, stays on her back in nap (she curls against it)
legs x2 (asphalt trousers, iron boots): layer 1; hip; 6-frame swing, tuck in hop and nap, forward in sit
jacket torso (concrete bands, zip, snow strip, slate straps): layer 2; hip; breath 1 px
far sleeve (concrete, a tone back, iron hand): layer 1 (E/W), 3 (S); chest; swing, guard
hood (concrete, lit lip, shaded lining): layer 4; chest; drapes 1 px late on hop, falls forward over the screen in nap
face-screen (asphalt glass, iron bezel, cyan glyph, crack): layer 5; head; glyph swaps per state (crescent idle, ! hit, ^ ^ cheer, z nap)
near sleeve (concrete, strip, iron hand): layer 6; chest; swing, wind-up, strike, cast, tap in fidget
options.pose: Square and unhurried, hands loose, the box riding high: the last courier on the 3 a.m. round.
notes: Works: a round hood on a tall box is a silhouette no other folk has; the crescent is the DND icon.
Screen: dark asphalt glass with a stepped upper-left sheen; the crack is dark with a lit west edge.
Risk: concrete hood and jacket are one value; the strip and box edges carry the read at 2 px.
Compared with Eastward 05: John's backpack (one big block, lit top edge) and jacket folds in 3 bands.

options.label: B
options.name: Antenna hood: snug asphalt hood with two bumps, visor screen, sling box at the hip
options.question: A snug cropped hood with two antenna bumps and a wide visor screen ("z z"); the pack is a slim stencilled box slung at her right hip with a pink light strip.
parts: sling box (concrete, stencil, pink strip and logo): layer 0 in W (far hip), 4 in S/E; hip (right); swings a frame behind on walk, bumps on hop
legs x2 (slate trousers, tall iron boots): layer 1; hip; long 6-frame stride
cropped jacket (asphalt bands, zip, rib waistband, snow strip, concrete strap): layer 2; hip; breath 1 px
far sleeve (asphalt, a tone back): layer 1/3; chest; swing, guard
hood with antenna bumps (asphalt): layer 5; chest; bumps twitch on hit and cheer (antenna = ears)
visor (iron bezel, asphalt glass, cyan "z z", crack): layer 6; head
near sleeve + wrist screen (asphalt, iron, cyan list): layer 7; chest; swing, strike, cast, fidget check
options.pose: Leggy and alert, bumps up, weight ready to go: she has one more drop before dawn.
notes: Works: bumps make a cat-eared hood that reads at 2 px; long legs and a high crop set her apart. The "z Z" is 4-5 px tall (a 3 px z reads as an I).
Wrist screen gives the fidget (checks the parcel list) and a natural cast pose.
Risk: an asphalt hood and jacket at night go very dark: the strip and the visor must carry it.
Compared with Eastward 05: John and the woman in teal (2-3 tone sleeves, a clear hem row).

options.label: C
options.name: Long parka, TV head: hood down as a roll, iron TV head, box worn on the front
options.question: A long reflective parka with the hood down as a thick roll; a boxy TV-shaped head; the delivery box worn on her front.
parts: hood (asphalt, down: a quilted roll and a lump at the back): layer 0 (lump), 3 (roll); chest
legs x2 (asphalt, iron boots): layer 1; hip; short steps under the hem
parka (asphalt bands, open front, snow hem band): layer 2; hip; the hem sways 1 px after each step
delivery box on the chest (concrete, stencil, pink logo, neck straps): layer 4; chest; bobs with breath, held in both arms in the nap
TV head (iron casing, rivets, side vents, asphalt glass, cyan closed-eye arcs, crack): layer 5; chest; tilts in idle, flips its picture in the fidget
sleeves x2 (asphalt, strip, iron hands): layer 1/6; chest; swing, smack, strike, cast
options.pose: Patient, boxy and a little old-fashioned, parcel held to her chest like something precious.
notes: Works: a square head over a bell parka is the most unlike the soft folk; the closed-eye arcs read at 2 px.
Risk: the hood down is the least hood-like; a 21 px TV is heavy and close to Bunk's robot look.
The box on the front blocks the chest in fights; strikes must come from the side.
Compared with Eastward 05: the woman in the purple cardigan (placket, a hem row) for the parka.

final.name: Antenna hood (final): snug bumped hood, glyph visor, slim box at the back of the hip
grafts: From A: a visor glyph per state: crescent (idle, ready), chevron (strike), ring (cast), X (hit), z (sit), heart (cheer), "z Z" (nap); the fidget dims it while she reads her wrist.

From A: the delivery box bigger (8-9 x 14) and readable: lit top edge and glint, lid seam, stencil, pink logo and a pink light strip; slim at the back of the right hip, one anchor and layer 0 in every facing.
From C (craft): the crack across the visor in every view, and fold bands on the jacket.
Fix: reflective strips with a lit top edge (snow 5-4) and a shaded lower edge (snow 3-2), the east end a step down.
Fix: the asphalt jacket in its full ramp (1 to 5) with a concrete yoke, rib waistband, rib cuffs and knee pads.
parts: familiar perch: back shoulder (E: x smaller, W: x larger), behind the hood; layer -1; chest
delivery box (concrete, lid seam, stencil, pink logo and light strip): layer 0; back of the right hip; all facings the same anchor (S: screen left, E/W: behind the hip); swings a frame late on walk
far leg / far sleeve (slate / asphalt, a tone back, concrete knee pad and cuff): layer 1; hip / chest
near leg (slate, concrete knee pad, iron boot): layer 2; hip; long 6-frame stride, forward in sit, tucked in cheer
jacket (asphalt bands and folds, concrete yoke and rib, snow strip, sling strap): layer 3; hip; breath 1 px
hood with antenna bumps (asphalt, crown seam, brow over the visor, chin step): layer 4; chest; bumps lift 1 px on hit and cheer
visor (iron bezel, asphalt glass, crack, cyan glyph per state): layer 5; head; glyph swaps on state change
near sleeve + wrist screen (asphalt, snow band, concrete cuff, iron hand): layer 6; chest; swing, strike (full reach), cast (wrist up, a cyan ring), fidget check
final.pose: Leggy and alert, bumps up, weight ready to go: one more drop before dawn.
notes: Compared side by side with Eastward 05 at the same height: John (jacket in 3 fold bands, one big pack block with a lit top edge), the woman in teal and the woman in the purple cardigan (sleeves and hem rows).
Works: cat-eared hood and lit visor read at 2 px day or night; long legs give a clear stride; the box never blocks the perch.
Night: asphalt is dark; the yoke, strips, knee pads, visor and box carry the read. Keep Pendle's coat lighter than hers (cast clash).
Open: the bumps edge towards animal ears; they stay square-topped (antennae), never pointed.
